findings.title: Validation error message leaks raw input
findings.body: The error message on line 8 includes the raw input `raw` via an f-string, which can expose sensitive data (e.g., passwords, tokens) in logs or error responses. Use the cleaned value `cleaned` in the message instead.

findings.title: Unused variable in old code path
findings.body: The old implementation returned `raw.strip().lower()` directly, but the new code assigns it to `cleaned` and then validates it. The variable is unused in the old path, which could confuse maintainers. Remove the assignment if the old path is no longer needed.

summary.problem: The email normalization function now validates input but leaks raw data in error messages and retains unused code.
summary.done_well: The new validation ensures addresses contain '@' before processing, improving correctness.
